title: Half-circle patch, three-quarter view
caption: The curved front patch remains isolated while the crown, sides, and back stay closely shaved.
patternDescription: A short dark tuft is framed by uniform scalp stubble; the three-quarter angle shows its position and raised texture without changing the silhouette.
lengthDescription: Near-shaved over the whole head except for the compact front patch, which is left slightly longer and dense.
